_: Beat prose. Authored, not generated by build-story.mjs — that script merges this in, so regenerating structure never destroys text. Follows docs/VOICE.md: depth is the clock, ⟦word⟧ marks a maskable concept, everything outside the brackets is always visible. No quantities in prose (readouts.ts owns numbers). No word implying calibrated doubt — the game estimates no confidence, so machine output is unchecked, never unsure. Present tense: the player is standing at the fork, never reading a report.

c0.title: Intake
c0.body: Everything is ⟦entity⟧ until we say otherwise. It is the one word nobody has asked us to check. Below it the work divides, and the division goes on file under your name.

c2.title: Signed Off Upstream
c2.body: ⟦physical entity⟧ was signed off before you arrived. Everything under it can be weighed, which is why we report on this side and not the other.

c1.title: Nothing To Weigh
c1.body: Nothing under ⟦abstraction⟧ can be lifted or weighed, so the machines file here fastest. Every way down is open. None of them is checked.

c13.title: Whoever Filed It
c13.body: ⟦causal agent⟧ is whatever made something happen. The machines file causes at a rate we publish weekly. Nothing on the record says who read it.

c15.title: Counted Once
c15.body: ⟦object⟧ is anything you can point at and count once. What sits below was made, and nothing filed says by whom.

c4.title: Held Against Nothing
c4.body: An ⟦attribute⟧ is what a thing is like, held against nothing in particular. Two ways down are open and both are being filled while you stand here.

c10.title: Inside Only
c10.body: ⟦psychological feature⟧ holds what happens inside and leaves no trace outside. We file it anyway, at the same rate as everything else.

c11.title: Between Two Things
c11.body: A ⟦relation⟧ is not a thing. It is what sits between two of them, and it is filed as though it were a thing.

c6.title: Something Happened
c6.body: ⟦event⟧ means something happened. The record does not say to whom, and the machines are filing under it faster than anyone is reading.

c7.title: Filed Together
c7.body: A ⟦group⟧ is things filed together. Nothing requires them to have anything in common, and below here most of them do not.

c16.title: Still Running
c16.body: A ⟦process⟧ has not finished, so nothing about it can be confirmed yet. It is filed as confirmed.

c14.title: What It Is Made Of
c14.body: ⟦matter⟧ is what a thing is made of, before anyone asks what it is for. One way down holds together. The others do not.

c8.title: Against A Scale
c8.body: ⟦measure⟧ is a thing held against a scale someone agreed on. The agreement is not filed here. Only the number is.

c175.title: Alive Or Filed As Alive
c175.body: ⟦organism⟧ is the line between alive and not. Below it the machines have been filing for longer than anyone here has been reading.

c228.title: Parts, Counted Once
c228.body: A ⟦whole⟧ is parts counted once, on the understanding that nobody recounts. Below here the parts stop agreeing on what they belong to.

c144.title: Held By Someone
c144.body: ⟦possession⟧ is a thing with a holder attached. The holder is a field. Nothing checks it.

c96.title: People, Filed
c96.body: A ⟦social group⟧ is people, filed. The filing outlives the people and keeps being served.

c246.title: Observed, Not Explained
c246.body: A ⟦phenomenon⟧ is something observed. Nothing under it is explained, and the record does not distinguish the two.

c190.title: Holds Its Shape
c190.body: ⟦solid⟧ holds its shape until something else acts on it. That is the whole definition, and it is the last one down here that fits on a line.

c65.title: Someone Did It
c65.body: An ⟦act⟧ is an event with someone behind it. The name of the someone is not a field.

c108.title: Measured By Itself
c108.body: A ⟦fundamental quantity⟧ is measured against nothing but itself. Everything under it inherits that, whether or not it earns it.

c106.title: Settled Already
c106.body: A ⟦definite quantity⟧ is settled before anyone looks at it. Below here the settling stops matching what was settled.

c42.title: Outline Only
c42.body: ⟦shape⟧ is the outline and nothing inside it. Two ways down, and the graph no longer files them the way you were taught.

c138.title: One Against Another
c138.body: A ⟦magnitude relation⟧ holds one size against another. Neither size is filed. Only the holding.

c125.title: Why It Moved
c125.body: ⟦motivation⟧ is why something moved. It is inferred and then stored as though it were observed.

c803.title: Kept Doing
c803.body: ⟦activity⟧ is an act that kept going. Nothing checks whether it should have. It continues below.

c500.title: Closed Outline
c500.body: A ⟦figure⟧ is a shape that closed. What is under it was closed by the graph, not by anyone. It continues either way.
